title: Line of investigation (ledger/lines.jsonl)
description: One thread of the program's work. An `open` record starts a line; `update` records change where it stands (the latest value of each field wins); `note` records say what happened to it on one night. `program map` builds the scientist's page from these.

by.description: Who opened the line, changed it or made the decision the note records

question.description: What the line is for, in the scientist's words where the scientist asked it

question_source.description: Where the question's wording comes from

reason.description: Why the line was opened, for a line the agent opened

parent.description: The line this one branched from

night.description: The session date a note is about, or the night an open or update belongs to

status.description: A line the agent opens starts proposed and runs only once the scientist makes it active

purpose.description: What the line is for, in two to four plain sentences for someone who wasn't there: what it is trying to find out or build, why the program needs that, and how it differs from the lines near it. Kept current as the line's aim changes

state.description: Where the line stands now, for someone who reads nothing else

next.description: What the line does next, or what it is waiting for (a job, an answer, another line)

closes_when.description: What result or decision would close the line, and what would keep it going

pinned.description: Things this line always keeps current and shows first: its current algorithm, its phase diagram, its amplitude plot. Each lives in one file, lines/<line>/pinned/<slug>.<md|svg|png|jpg|txt>, rewritten in place whenever what it shows changes; the dashboard shows the latest and every earlier version from the file's history. A record with a slug already pinned replaces its title and description; `removed` unpins it.

slug.description: The file's name without its extension

about.description: What it must show, so whoever makes it knows when it is right

feeds.description: Lines that use this line's result

kind.description: For example: code branch, evidence, design, plan, figure

experiments.description: Experiments placed in this line by this record: ones registered before lines existed, or moved here. A registration's own line_id is the usual way.

text.description: A note: what happened to the line that night, in two or three plain sentences

waiting.description: A note: the line can't move without the scientist

planned.description: A note: work planned for that night, not yet done
